scope: For the shortcut Collatz map, every finite set of natural offsets has a dyadic progression of positive translating integers on which all trajectories coalesce at a common finite time with equal odd counts. Power-of-two endpoint specialization gives arbitrarily large translates that first reach one at a common finite time, with every earlier iterate greater than one. This includes consecutive runs of every prescribed length. The result does not prove convergence from arbitrary prescribed starting values.
